summary.headline: Astrological Chapters 144–162
summary.text: Astrological chapter list covering fortunate births, the Chaldaean dodecaeteris and twelve fruits, planetary activity in body parts, genethlialogical year alteration, royal familiarization, star joys, conception and womb nourishment, Indian methods concerning authorities, lots of education and prudence, paternity, inquiries, Saturn’s glories, inceptions, planetary significations, the Moon in an uninjured nativity horoskopos, and horoskopos as body with its lord as soul.
